title: Cascader
description: Selects a value from a hierarchy of options, one level at a time (e.g. country / region / city).

keyboard.title: Keyboard and accessibility
keyboard.open: Enter, Space or Arrow Down on the input opens the panel and moves focus into it; focusing the input alone does not open it.
keyboard.navigate: Arrow Up / Arrow Down, Home and End move within a column.
keyboard.expand: Arrow Right or Enter expands the next column (also after lazy loading) and Enter selects a leaf; Arrow Left goes back to the previous column.
keyboard.close: Escape closes the panel and returns focus to the input; Tab closes it.

import { ref } from "vue";
import { Cascader, VStack } from "minerva-design/vue";
const options = [
  {
    value: "eu",
    label: "Europe",
    children: [
      { value: "fr", label: "France" },
      { value: "de", label: "Germany" },
    ],
  },
  {
    value: "asia",
    label: "Asia",
    children: [
      { value: "jp", label: "Japan" },
      { value: "sg", label: "Singapore" },
    ],
  },
];
const value = ref<(string | number)[]>([]);
</script>
<template>
  <VStack :gap="3" align="stretch"
    ><Cascader
      v-model="value"
      :options="options"
      label="Region"
      name="region"
    /><output>{{ value.join(" / ") }}</output></VStack
  >
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
import { Cascader } from "minerva-design/vue";
import type { CascaderOption } from "minerva-design/vue";
const options = ref<CascaderOption[]>([{ value: "eu", label: "Europe" }]);
async function load(path: CascaderOption[]) {
  const item = path[path.length - 1]!;
  item.loading = true;
  await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 400));
  item.children = [
    { value: "fr", label: "France", isLeaf: true },
    { value: "de", label: "Germany", isLeaf: true },
  ];
  item.loading = false;
}
</script>
<template>
  <Cascader
    :options="options"
    label="Lazy locations"
    name="lazy-location"
    :load-data="load"
  />
</template>

translationResources.title: Cascader
translationResources.description: Selects a value from a hierarchy of options, one level at a time (e.g. country / region / city).

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Click the input (or press Enter, Space or Arrow Down) to open the panel, then click an option to open the next level; choosing a leaf completes the selection. The dropdown grows with its columns.

default-value.title: Default value
default-value.description: defaultValue takes the path of values, one per level.

controlled.title: Controlled
controlled.description: Pass value and update it in onChange. Clearing calls onChange with an empty array.

hover.title: Expand on hover
hover.description: With expandTrigger="hover", sub-menus open when the pointer hovers a parent option.

search.title: Search
search.description: showSearch lets users type to filter every path; filter customizes the matching.

display-render.title: Custom display
display-render.description: displayRender formats the text shown in the input; here only the last level is displayed and allowClear is off.

disabled.title: Disabled
disabled.description: Disable individual options with option.disabled, or the whole component with disabled.

lazy-load.title: Load options lazily
lazy-load.description: Clicking an option that has no children and is not isLeaf expands it and calls loadData instead of selecting it. Set loading on the option, add its children to options when they arrive, and mark the loaded leaves with isLeaf: true so they can be selected.

custom-option.title: Custom options and levels
custom-option.description: optionRender renders each option with its level, maxLevel limits the depth (an option at the last level is selected), and dropdownStyle / optionStyle adjust the menu.

CascaderProps.label: Label of the input
CascaderProps.name: Name of the input
CascaderProps.value: Selected path of values (controlled; pair with onChange)
CascaderProps.onChange: Called when a leaf option is selected or the value is cleared
CascaderProps.displayRender: Formats the text shown in the input; by default labels are joined with " / "
CascaderProps.placeholder: Placeholder of the input; defaults to a localized "Please select"
CascaderProps.allowClear: Shows a clear button (labelled "Clear selection", localized) when a value is selected
CascaderProps.showSearch: Allows typing to search all paths
CascaderProps.filter: Custom search predicate; by default paths whose labels contain the input match
CascaderProps.loadData: Loads children lazily: clicking an option that has no children and is not isLeaf expands it and calls loadData with its path (instead of selecting it). Add the children to options yourself; set loading on the option meanwhile
CascaderProps.dropdownClassName: Additional class name of the dropdown
CascaderProps.maxLevel: Maximum number of levels shown; an option at the last level is selected
CascaderProps.style: Inline styles of the root element
CascaderProps.aria-label: Accessible label of the input; overrides label and the label of an enclosing FormControl
CascaderProps.aria-labelledby: Id(s) of the element(s) labelling the input
CascaderProps.aria-describedby: Id(s) of the element(s) describing the input; merged with the helper / error text of an enclosing FormControl
CascaderProps.id: Id of the input; defaults to the id of an enclosing FormControl
CascaderProps.required: Marks the input as required (aria-required); defaults to the enclosing FormControl's state
CascaderProps.readOnly: Shows the value without allowing changes (the dropdown does not open); defaults to the enclosing FormControl's state
CascaderProps.invalid: Marks the input as invalid (aria-invalid); defaults to the enclosing FormControl's state

CascaderOption.value: Value of the option, unique among its siblings
CascaderOption.label: Text displayed for the option
CascaderOption.disabled: Prevents the option from being selected
CascaderOption.isLeaf: Marks the option as a leaf (no children to load) when using loadData
CascaderOption.loading: Shows a loading indicator while its children are being loaded

keyboard.title: Keyboard and accessibility
keyboard.open: Enter, Space or Arrow Down on the input opens the panel and moves focus into it; focusing the input alone does not open it.
keyboard.navigate: Arrow Up / Arrow Down, Home and End move within a column.
keyboard.expand: Arrow Right or Enter expands the next column (also after lazy loading) and Enter selects a leaf; Arrow Left goes back to the previous column.
keyboard.close: Escape closes the panel and returns focus to the input; Tab closes it.
keyboard.aria: The input has the combobox role. Its default placeholder and the "Clear selection" button label follow the React library's locale.

cssVars.--cascader-height: Minimum height of the field (defaults to the density's small control height)
cssVars.--cascader-radius: Corner radius of the field, the dropdown and the options (defaults to --radius-sm)
cssVars.--cascader-font-size: Font size of the field and of the options
cssVars.--cascader-border-color: Border color of the field at rest
cssVars.--cascader-column-min-width: Minimum width of a column of options
cssVars.--cascader-dropdown-max-height: Maximum height of the columns before they scroll
cssVars.--cascader-option-padding-y: Vertical padding of an option (follows the density's row padding)
cssVars.--cascader-option-padding-x: Horizontal padding of an option (follows the density's row padding)

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: The option tree is the options property; the value attribute sets the default path (comma-separated or JSON array). minerva-change reports the selected path.

search-hover.title: Search, hover and display
search-hover.description: show-search filters every path as you type, expand-trigger="hover" opens sub-menus on hover, and displayRender formats the field (here only the last label). Disabled options cannot be picked.

lazy.title: Lazy loading
lazy.description: With loadData, activating an option without children expands it and loads its children: set loading, add children, then reassign options.

form.title: In a form
form.description: The element is form-associated: it submits the displayed text under name, required blocks an empty selection, and form.reset() restores the value attribute.

props.readOnly: Shows the value without allowing changes (the panel does not open).
props.hideClearButton: Hides the clear button (allowClear={false} in React).
props.selectedOptions: Options of the selected path, one per level (read-only).
props.isDisabled: Whether the control is disabled (itself or by a disabled <fieldset>).
props.labels: The <label> elements associated with the element.
props.validationMessage: Message describing the current validation error (empty when valid).
props.willValidate: Whether the element takes part in constraint validation.

events.minerva-change: A path was selected or the value was cleared (detail: { value, selectedOptions }).
events.minerva-clear: The clear button emptied the value.
events.minerva-input: The search text changed (show-search; detail: { value }).
events.minerva-open-change: The user asked to open or close the panel (detail: { open }); cancelable: preventDefault() keeps the current state.

methods.blur: Removes focus from the inner input.
methods.checkValidity: Checks validity; fires invalid when the value is invalid.
methods.reportValidity: Checks validity and shows the browser's validation message.
methods.setCustomValidity: Sets a custom validation error (an empty string clears it).
methods.formResetCallback: Called by the browser on form.reset(): restores the value attribute.
methods.formDisabledCallback: Called by the browser when an ancestor <fieldset> is disabled or enabled.
methods.formStateRestoreCallback: Called by the browser to restore the value (back/forward cache, autofill).
